title: Lisle County Board of Elections
summary: A county board of elections (24 precincts at 12 polling locations, an Early Vote Center, one drop box, paper ballots on precinct scanners and electronic pollbooks loaded from the county voter registration system) and a tabletop exercise generated from its simulated plans: altered voter records from a phished staff account during early voting, a spoofed polling-location notice and false claims about the voting equipment.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. Lisle County, its board of elections, people, polling locations, contests and identifiers are simulated, and no real candidate, party or election result is depicted; the public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/county-elections/SOURCES.md.

scenarios.title: Ghost Poll Pads
scenarios.summary: Five days before Election Day, early voters are told their mail ballot was already issued; the audit trail shows overnight changes to 1,186 voter records from a phished clerk's account, a spoofed email tells poll workers that Polling Location 6 moved, and a viral video claims the county deleted voters and put the scanners online. The board must freeze changes, decide what to do with the final pollbook load and tell voters how to vote with confidence.
